claims.text: Yes. NETGEAR's total liability for damages in any action arising out of the Agreement is capped. The cap amount is redacted in the source as [*], so the sources do not state the dollar figure.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL NETGEAR's OR BAY NETWORKS' TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGES IN ANY ACTION BASED ON OR ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE AGREEMENT EXCEED THE [*] TO NETGEAR PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT.

claims.text: The Distributor's total liability is also capped, using the same redacted [*] amount. The source text reads 'WELL' where 'WILL' is presumably meant.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WELL DISTRIBUTOR's TOTAL LIABILITY FOR ANY DAMAGES IN ANY ACTION BASED ON OR ARISING OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE AGREEMENT EXCEED THE [*] TO NETGEAR PURSUANT TO THE AGREEMENT.

claims.text: Excluded from NETGEAR's cap: damages arising under Sections 14.A and 16.A. Section 16.A is the NETGEAR indemnity for third-party bodily injury, death, or property claims, and 14.A is the NETGEAR indemnity for intellectual property infringement claims.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING UNDER SECTIONS 14.A AND 16.A, IN NO EVENT WILL NETGEAR's OR BAY NETWORKS' TOTAL LIABILITY
NETGEAR agrees to indemnify Distributor against any claim arising out of or resulting from the Products or the Agreement

NETGEAR agrees to defend at its own expense any action brought against Distributor to the extent that it is based on a claim that any Product infringes a United States or Territory patent, copyright, trade mark, trade secret or other valid intellectual property right

claims.text: Excluded from the Distributor's cap: damages arising from breach of Sections 6.C and 12, 13 or 17. Section 17 concerns foreign reshipment and export restrictions.

citations.quote: EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES ARISING FROM BREACH OF SECTIONS 6.C AND 12,13 OR 17
This Agreement is made subject to all laws, regulations, orders or other restrictions on the export from the United States of Products

claims.text: Separately from the cap, both parties are excluded from liability for substitute procurement costs, special, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages, and for inaccurate or lost data, loss of use or profits. The sources show no carve-outs from this exclusion.

citations.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL EITHER PARTY OR THEIR RESPECTIVE PARENT CORPORATIONS OR SUPPLIERS BE LIABLE FOR (1) THE COST OF SUBSTITUTE PROCUREMENT, SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES, OR (2) ANY DAMAGES RESULTING FROM INACCURATE OR LOST DATA OR LOSS OF USE OR PROFITS
